summary: Iteration 2 testing complete for SRA. All 39 pytest cases PASS: 27 regression (test_sra_api.py) + 12 new-feature (test_sra_new_features.py) covering (a) public /api/impact/public unauth, (b) Gemini semantic_skills persistence + usage in matching, (c) NGO ownership enforcement on /api/match/run (403 for non-owner NGO, 200 for admin), (d) notifications CRUD end-to-end (match_created on run, match_accepted on respond, task_completed on complete, single read, mark-all-read, 401 unauth). Frontend verified via Playwright: /impact public page renders stats/heatmap/leaderboard/categories without auth; NotificationsBell renders on volunteer & NGO portals with unread badge (seen '2'), dropdown opens, mark-all-read wired; NGO portal shows TEST_ tasks incl. 'Semantic First Aid Camp'. Google Maps fallback to Leaflet confirmed (REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY empty; Leaflet tiles visible on /impact, /volunteer, /ngo).

minor.issue: Gemini semantic_skills expansion is synchronous inside the request (awaited via asyncio.gather with translation under 25-35s timeout). Task creation latency observed ~4-10s on healthy path. Consider moving semantic expansion + translation to a background job so the POST returns immediately with status='pending_enrichment'.
No caching; every hit performs 6 counts + 3 aggregations + 2 finds. For a public, unauth endpoint this is a DoS vector. Add a 60s in-memory or Mongo materialized cache.

issues: Leaflet attribution/tile credit not visible in viewport (may be cropped). Verify OSM attribution remains visible per Leaflet license terms.
Dropdown positioned partially off-canvas on narrow viewports in some pages (observed during volunteer portal test). Consider right-aligning with max-width on smaller screens.

action_items: (Optional perf) Cache /api/impact/public for 30-60s to protect the public endpoint.
(Optional perf) Move Gemini semantic_skills + translation to background task so POST /api/tasks returns fast; frontend can poll or use websocket.
(Optional UX) Right-align NotificationsBell dropdown on <768px and ensure Leaflet OSM attribution remains visible.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1354 lines — continues to exceed 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into routers: auth.py, tasks.py, matching.py, notifications.py, impact.py, rewards.py, admin.py.
create_notification writes documents inline without a Pydantic model — response shape not validated. Define NotificationOut and use response_model=.
Notification polling interval in NotificationsBell is client-driven — every volunteer hammers the API every N seconds. Consider Server-Sent Events or at least exponential back-off when unread==0.
run_matching ownership check lives in the handler; consider a FastAPI dependency (`ensure_task_owner`) to apply uniformly on respond/complete/delete in future.
Public impact heatmap returns raw lat/lng of OPEN tasks — low PII risk but if a task location is a survivor's home it leaks. Rounding to ~2 decimal places (≈1km grid) would be safer.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested flows (public impact, bell on vol+ngo, mark-all-read, NGO dashboard)
